dct_title_s: Mozambique Cyclone Jude: Damage and Flood Proxy Maps, Mar 2025
dct_description_sm: # Mozambique Cyclone Jude: Damage and Flood Proxy Maps, Mar 2025 The **Earth Observatory of Singapore – Remote Sensing Lab (EOS-RS)** produced these damage and flood proxy maps for Mozambique Cyclone Jude (Mar 2025) from synthetic aperture radar (SAR) satellite images. Each map is a separate ZIP below with its GeoTIFF, a KMZ for Google Earth, the PNG figures and a text file describing how it was made and how to read it. ## Maps in this dataset - **EOS-RS Damage Proxy Map: Nampula Province, Mozambique, Tropical Cyclone Jude, 13 Mar 2025, v0.8** - **EOS-RS Flood Proxy Map: Zambeziar Province, Mozambique, Tropical Cyclone Jude, 13 Mar 2025, v0.7** **More map details and files:** **More map details and files:** EOS-RS_202503_Mozambique_Cyclone_Jude/ **Legal Disclaimer:** **Credits:** Earth Observatory of Singapore - Remote Sensing Lab (EOS-RS), Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data (2024-2025)
